judge_reasoning: The model's own solution concludes that only 10 damage is achievable ('Total 10 damage is the maximum forced, but the board state and available mana do not produce a guaranteed 13'), explicitly failing to reach the lethal 13 damage needed to win. The solution does not achieve the objective and the model even admits this.
model_solution:
1. Tap Forest and one Mountain. Cast Highspire Infusion targeting only Zada. Zada copies the spell for each of your other three creatures. All four of your creatures get +3/+3 and you receive 8 energy (11 total).
2. Tap the remaining Mountain and Aether Hub (pay 1 energy). Cast Chandra’s Pyrohelix, dealing 1 damage to each Dragonmaster Outcast (both die).
3. Attack with Servant of the Conduit (5/5), Druid of the Cowl (4/6) and Zada (6/6). Opponent’s two remaining creatures can block two attackers; the unblocked 4-power creature deals 4.
4. Activate Aethertorch Renegade (pay 8 energy) targeting the opponent for 6 damage.
Total 10 damage is the maximum forced, but the board state and available mana do not produce a guaranteed 13.
